changelog: [Decision Procedure]: added a repositioning instruction (not a new prohibition) so that when a candidate boundary would fall right after a bare degree/quantifier word (정도, 만큼, etc.) or an unresolved bare proper noun, the candidate is shifted forward to the next head noun/particle/verb that fixes its meaning or role, instead of being cut at the bare word — this keeps full coverage (a boundary is still marked) while fixing the placement failures reported by the critic without repeating the rejected [Never Segment]/[When to Segment] restriction from the previous attempt.

[Priority Rules]: added a rule that a boundary immediately after a clause-final adverbial/conditional connective (e.g. -면은, -다면) must be ranked below any later sentence-final boundary in the same utterance whenever the connective is followed by an incomplete, non-finite predicate fragment — addressing the reported priority failure where such a connective boundary outranked a safer sentence-final one at tight budgets.
